articles.summary: ATLANTA, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Atlanticus Holdings Corporation (NASDAQ: ATLC) (“Atlanticus,” the “Company,” “we,” “our” or “us”), a financial technology company that enables its bank, retail and healthcare partners to offer more inclusive financial services to millions of everyday Americans, today announced that Jeff Howard, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Bill McCamey, Chief Financial Officer, will participate in the KBW Fintech Ecosystem Conference in New York, NY on November 10-12, 2026. Jeff Howard will participate in a fireside chat titled “Beyond the Credit Score: Expanding Access without Buying Losses” on Thursday, November 12 at 12:25pm. Information regarding the conference will also be available in the Events and Presentations section of the Company’s Investor Relations website at https://investors.atlanticus.com .
